adaptations: TypeScript erasure and module factory for Qt JS
RegExp matchAll uses a Qt PCRE matcher with named groups and UTF16 offsets
RegExp source/flags are serialized directly to avoid Qt slash re-escaping
Whitespace classes use the exact JavaScript set while decimal escapes remain ASCII
Array.at(-1) becomes copying slice; String.trimEnd uses the exact JavaScript whitespace set
File position object spread becomes Object.assign; slash replaceAll becomes split/join
